invariants.rationale: If metrics are enabled, this.metrics should be present, otherwise it should be empty.
If metrics are enabled, metrics is set to a new HoodieMetadataMetrics.
this.metrics is always assigned (never left uninitialized).
When metrics are enabled, metrics config is passed to HoodieMetadataMetrics and should not be null.
When metrics are enabled, storage is passed to HoodieMetadataMetrics and should not be null.
